suite.index_note: The public index averages the 37 benchmarks of the 0.2.1 panel in five areas, with GSM8K rebuilt and ForecastBench retired. Each benchmark is chance-corrected first, (score - chance) / (1 - chance) clipped to 0-1, so 0 means random guessing and 100 means perfect. Every score is coverage-adjusted, so an unanswered or unsupported request counts as wrong. The headline Full score blends this public index with private tests; benchmarks marked + also show each model's score on the private benchmark of the same competency.
changes: The main ranking is the Full score: 20% public benchmarks, 50% private tests of the same skills and 30% private tasks from new domains, each put on the public scale using untuned stock models. Most of the score comes from tests nobody can train on, so a public-only advantage counts for little.
GSM8K is rebuilt, ForecastBench is retired from the public index, and WinoGrande now counts under Knowledge & Reasoning.
